title: Jude and the Machine
author: Rosalind Thackeray
blurb: Freya Hartwell, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
